summary:
The Lunar Landing Site Planner is an interactive web application designed to explore the Moon, examine potential landing locations, and understand some of the environmental and operational challenges involved in lunar missions.
The application combines interactive lunar maps, 3D visualisation, equipment placement, scientific calculations, location comparisons, and a lunar exploration simulator.
Its main objective is to help users investigate how a selected location and mission time can affect sunlight availability, solar energy generation, communication with Earth, and the operation of equipment on the lunar surface.
The application is organised into several sections, each providing a different set of tools for lunar exploration and preliminary mission planning. It also includes an interesting game based on scientific facts to explore moon places.
details:
What it does. Lunar Landing Site Planner is our web app for exploring the Moon and judging possible landing sites. Users pick a location on a 2D map or 3D globe, place a moon base or solar array, and see how sunlight, solar energy, Earth visibility for communication, and darkness change over time. Saved sites can be scored and compared, and a 3D simulator lets users drive a rover, astronaut and other equipment.

Benefits and impact. It shows students and the public, in one place, why location and timing decide whether a lunar mission has power and contact with Earth.

Tools. A single HTML file using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, Leaflet.js and a GeoTIFF library, with NASA Moon Trek, LROC and LOLA data. No installation, server or special hardware; it only needs internet.

Creativity. It joins mapping, energy calculations, mission equipment and a playable 3D simulator in one tool.

Factors considered. Scientific honesty: estimates are approximate and labelled, missing data layers are stated clearly, and it is an educational tool, not a certified landing-safety system

our web app abilities are:

compering: It can compare the light, energy and best place for solar panel and landing on different places on the moon.

Map and location: It Has a map of the moon and can see the sky on different locations of the moon and also has a moon rover, mini helicopter, solar panel and a moon base.

 you can see where is the earth and sun on different locations of the moon.

Estimating: Can estimate the place of moon and earth for 30 days.

Can see the hills and holes on the surface moon.

Our goal is: Finding the best place for landing. and having moon base and solar panel on it and having a new life on moon and exploring the moon.
